note: Kit colour amendments (15.11.2026): each record fills colours into the pack kit of the same id, only where that kit names none and only when two independent publishers agree (status approved). Single-publisher records stay in review for the owner.

1994-95 Atalanta Match Issue Home Shirt #2 – Classic Football Shirts

kits.notes: Coral shirt with blue trim and an embossed image of the Renaissance stand: Football Kit Archive's description ('coral', embossed stand) and the Colours of Football drawing (coral body, blue collar and trim, embossed stand) agree. FKA's own colours field (red/blue/black) contradicts its description and is not used. Colours of Football alone shows coral shorts and socks: not set.

Blue and black vertical stripes (Asics, Somet): the Classic Football Shirts photograph and the it.wikipedia season kit (blue body, black stripes) agree. Wikipedia alone gives black shorts and socks: not set.

One publisher: the Classic Football Shirts photograph of a match-issue 1994-95 home shirt shows blue and black stripes (Lotto); the listing notes a Somet sponsor applied over the 1993-94 Tamoil one. No second publisher found; held for the owner.
Colours read by eye from the record's own photograph on Football Kit Archive (the source the kit was approved on), 15.11.2026.

skipped.reason: No publisher with the colours found: FKA page text has none; no retailer or season kit found for 1993-94 away.
